s1: Northwind Robotics reported Q4 revenue of $48.2 million, up 12% year over year.
s2: Operating margin for the quarter was 8.4%, compared with 6.1% in the prior year.
s3: The company did not disclose segment-level revenue for its logistics division.
s4: Headcount fell to 1,240 at the end of Q4 from 1,310 at the end of Q3.
s5: Management guided to full-year 2026 revenue of $205 million to $215 million.
s6: Free cash flow was negative $3.1 million in Q4, the third consecutive negative quarter.
